bagPolicy.summary: Approved bags are clear plastic or vinyl up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, or small clutches approximately hand-sized. Medically necessary items are accepted after inspection.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the clear-bag policy
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Accessible parking is available first come, first served in Cherry Garage through University of Arizona Parking and Transportation.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Arena concessions accept cards and Apple Pay or Google Pay. A reverse ATM is available for guests carrying cash.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The south entry at Gates A and B is identified as the main accessible entry for McKale Center at ALKEME Arena.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The arena does not allow re-entry; guests who leave must buy a new ticket to return, and the ticket office closes at halftime.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will call is at the McKale Ticket Office on the south end at street level. On basketball game days, the office opens 90 minutes before tipoff.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The main south entry uses Gates A and B; other entry assignments can vary by event.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
